resources.string: Shown while this phone is lending its cellular to the zippie router.
The router console write token, so this phone can announce itself as a bond leg without anyone typing it. Reads are open; writes are not.

host:port of the router console on its own network, for example 10.20.0.1:8787. The LAN address, never the tailnet one - the tailnet console answers from anywhere, so announcing to it would tell a router to dial a private address on a network this phone is not on.
Public hostname of the home transport this phone relays to.
UDP port of the home transport. 1-65535; anything else is ignored.
UDP port the router dials on this phone. 1-65535; anything else is ignored, because binding 0 takes a random port and the router would dial one nothing is on.
Begin relaying without anyone opening the app. Absent means no - a phone must never start relaying because a key was missing.
Lets this phone report its own relay decisions over cellular, which is the only channel that survives the router being unreachable. Blank disables telemetry.
Intake host, e.g. datadoghq.com. Leave blank for US1.
Use this phone as a home screen

Only for a dedicated leg - a phone whose job is carrying the bond. It makes the bond status the phone\'s home screen. Leave this off for any phone somebody uses as a phone: turning it on makes Android ask which home app to use.
